_doc: Response of GET /api/v2/alltime?range=7d|30d|all (this file: range=30d). Mirrors the old _alltime_display() field names. Range-scoped: tokens, messages, sessions, active_days, fav_model, models, projects (unless projects_scope='all'), series, compare, usage. Lifetime: total, first_ts, last_ts, streak_current, streak_longest, peak_hour, heatmap. tokens = input + output + cache writes (cache reads excluded). peak_hour is a local hour 0-23 (the old app sent '10 AM'). usage holds sampled 5-hour/weekly used % over the range (<= ~800 points, gaps where the tracker was off). heatmap.days is Sunday-aligned, ~53 weeks ending today, lvl 0-4 relative to the busiest visible day. ready=false while the first full scan runs.
